_comment: The SHAPE v1 — Saint Helena collects, then creates. 47 voice lines in five strata: genesis (bones+wash, beatless), Lopes (the clock ticks dry, the sea opens at the marooning, the cockerel motif debuts), empire (the coin machine, the emperor theme falls, the slaves stretch is the darkest full groove then falls away under the [sighs]), the guests (Bb-major amahubo lift for Dinuzulu, crushed brass for the boers), the dream and the recipe (ingredients stack a layer per line, the water recedes on SOMETHING IS READY, one bare question, then THE MATCH DROPS — the only punch — eruption, afterglow, and a god born over almost nothing). Splits (v12 fast friends, v21 the sigh, v35 the whisper) are ESTIMATES — tune to rendered bars from timing.md after the voice pass. Litany (v30) stacks every theme: swell + emperordeep + cockerelghost + ohdearbell + bones.  BACK-HALF RE-SCORE (the trim): the essay lost 7 blocks and diverges from 29, so everything from STRATA on is re-shaped. The dream question now runs into the recipe on one bed (the recipe IS the answer). SOMETHING IS READY strips to a clock and the Ethiopia turn plays over a single bone — the fire needs somewhere to land. Then nine sections of eruption (intake, the lit fire, the crack, the magma drop, brimstone, THE BONES LEARN TO SING, the column, collapse, ash), and the album ends on an EAS broadcast: header, the 853+960 attention tone, the robot voice, end of message, and a carrier that fades out mid-sentence. Sections 0-30 (voice 0-28) were not touched.
